text: Sea's e-commerce cost of revenue rose 38.6%, from US$5.2 billion in 2023 to US$7.2 billion in 2024. This increase was primarily driven by higher logistics costs, which rose in line with a 33.0% jump in order volume, from 8.2 billion orders in 2023 to 10.9 billion orders in 2024 [Sea, FY2024, p.97].

answer: Sea's e-commerce cost of revenue rose 38.6%, from US$5.2 billion in 2023 to US$7.2 billion in 2024. This increase was primarily driven by higher logistics costs, which rose in line with a 33.0% jump in order volume, from 8.2 billion orders in 2023 to 10.9 billion orders in 2024 [Sea, FY2024, p.97].
